Radiology Service | Bravis Ziekenhuis | 10 February 2025
Subject: Multiparametric MRI Prostate
Clinical context: Re-evaluation of rising PSA (9.5 ng/mL) and prior positive biopsy. Current PI-RADS 3 on prior scan.

FINDINGS:
Prostatic volume registers at 49.29 mL. T2-weighted sequences reveal a faint hypointense area, roughly 12 mm, situated within the right mid-gland peripheral zone. Intermediate restriction on diffusion-weighted imaging accompanies a matching low ADC signal. Focal early enhancement appears on dynamic contrast-enhanced sequences against the background parenchyma. There is no evidence of extraprostatic extension, seminal vesicle invasion, or pelvic lymphadenopathy.

IMPRESSION:
PI-RADS 3 lesion in the right mid-gland. PSAD 0.193 ng/mL/mL.
csPCa predicted probability 0.6352939
